text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOf(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Premises:
German(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
Politician(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
MemberOf(heinrich, prussianStateParliament) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
MemberOf(heinrich, naziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
German(heinrich) ∨ Russian(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was German or Russian or both.
